text.text_excerpt: I was super excited when I found out a do-it-yourself yogurt place was coming to NOLA last summer. I love Pinkberry, but there's something to be desired from the way that they stick your toppings to the side of your fro yo and then fall off. I've probably been to Pure 20 times (I went weekly during the summer), and I've almost never been disappointed. The staff is always friendly to me, and there's NO LINE, which cannot be said about the Pinkberry on Magazine. I'm not a fan of the Who Dat, partially because I have fruit allergies and I want to know what's in it, and partially because it's purple. The tart and mango are delicious, creamy, and have slightly less tang than Pinkberry fro yo. ...

Awesome yogurt- great toppings- great flavors- quick & easy. I get 1/2 WhoDat & 1/2 Tart, topped with toasted coconut & mochi...and a blob or two of cookie dough for decadence. I came here because I heard someone talking about it at my favorite pedicure place, Amy's Nails . Someone was talking about braving the line and the clientelle at pinkberry and the lady next to me piped up that Pure in the riverbend was locally owned and run, and that the lines were shorter, the customers were nicer, and the yogurt was better. So I ran right over after my toes dried and they were SO right. Delicious! And everyone was so sweet in telling me how things went. I like the fact that the place is really j...

Pure is wonderful and the owner is not an arse. I love how several reviewers compliment that it's cheaper than other places, "a deal", and they love that it's self serve. Maybe the owner is a little grumbly because he has to deal with people all day helping themselves to toppings?? Free yogurt samples are one thing, but I'm pretty sure everyone knows what a raspberry or cookie dough bite tastes like, just sayin'... Anyhoodles onto the review: YAY! I love me some fro yo and love Pure...the yogurt is delicious, the toppings fresh (and fruity pebbles on who dat flavor mixed with tart is yummo), and I love that I can control how little or how much I want!
